summary: Backend-only testing for the NEW bulk directory scan feature (POST /api/admin/scan) and source_path fallback in /api/stream/{id}, /api/cover/{id}, DELETE /api/admin/mixes/{id}. Created /app/backend/tests/test_scan.py with 8 tests - all passed. Full regression (32/32) passed including iteration 1 suite.
critical_code_review_comments: scan_directory() writes the cue file into CUES_DIR/{mix.id}.cue for scanned mixes, but DELETE /api/admin/mixes/{id} DOES unlink that cue file. That's fine (it's a copy we own), BUT the source .cue on disk is correctly preserved. Verified.

_find_cover picks up generic 'cover.jpg' siblings - this causes ALL audio files in the same folder to share the same cover_path (e.g. orphan.mp3 in the test got cover.jpg even though it had no matching stem cue). Expected behavior but worth documenting.
scan_directory has no max-file-count safeguard - scanning a huge directory on a single HTTP request could time out or OOM. Consider background task or pagination.

CUE_TRACK_RE requires the FILE/TRACK lines to be well-formed; malformed cue sheets are silently parsed to empty/partial track lists without reporting back. Not a blocker but logs would help debugging.

AUDIO_EXTS in scan_directory includes .aac/.opus which were NOT in the problem statement's spec (mp3/flac/wav/m4a/ogg). These extras could ingest files the admin didn't intend. Low priority - makes the scan more permissive.
ScanRequest.default_genre has no length/whitelist validation; untrusted admin input is stored as-is. Acceptable for admin-only route.
seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/mixdeck_scan_test/ with 4 fake audio files (mix_a.mp3, mix_b.mp3, orphan.mp3, sub/sub_mix.mp3), matching cue files including one with PERFORMER "" (empty), plus cover.jpg. Test fixtures tear down both the DB records (via DELETE /api/admin/mixes/{id}) and the on-disk directory after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 2 scan tests green. Verified: (1) 401 without admin token, (2) 400 for non-existent path, (3) recursive scan ingests top-level + subfolder audio+cue+cover with correct track counts and titles/artists from cue header, (4) empty PERFORMER "" yields empty artist (NOT stray quote), (5) source_path and source_cover_path persisted correctly, (6) re-scan is idempotent with skipped reason 'already_ingested', (7) recursive=false excludes subfolders, (8) /api/stream/{id} serves source_path files with HTTP Range 206 + Content-Range + Accept-Ranges, (9) /api/cover/{id} serves source_cover_path with image content-type, (10) DELETE removes DB record but PRESERVES the source audio/cue/cover files on disk, (11) default_genre applied. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_scan.py is module-scoped and auto-cleans.
rca of the issue: No issues found during iteration 2 testing.
